full_name: CrossCountry ShiftApp – Train Manager Shift Log
data_policy: Shift details, trains and timestamped entries autosave locally in this browser using localStorage. Manual Save is also available. No server upload is configured.
update_policy: The app checks for updates on launch and at most once every 24 hours while open or when returning to the foreground. Updates use a versioned cache and do not clear locally saved shift data.
asset_layout: PDF exports use the supplied CrossCountry Voyager header image at exactly 10mm high across the printable page width on every page, with automatic page-number footers.
features: Restore archived shifts without creating duplicate archive copies: repeated restores of an already-active shift are idempotent, and an identical active shift is not archived again.
Explicit “Are you sure you want to archive this shift?” confirmation before archiving and clearing the active diary.
Shift diary archive: archive completed shifts locally, browse archived records, restore a copy, delete archived records, and export/import JSON backups including current and archived shifts
Lost property capture: found/handed-in source, item, identifying description, location, optional person details and handover/storage destination; timestamped and included in shift exports.
Live CrossCountry station-style digital clock at the top of the page, showing UK local time and date with automatic GMT/BST handling.
LED-style CrossCountry digital clock with illuminated seven-segment-inspired digits.
Incident entries are created from Add issue / log entry; a custom prompt captures an optional incident log number.
Reference-matched seven-segment LED clock with lime main digits and red seconds
Reference-matched seven-segment LED clock with smaller red seconds digits
Removed sequential incident follow-up entries; added standalone Update entry type
High-legibility LED clock with wider bevelled segments, brighter illumination and improved mobile sizing
Clock changed to clear standard system digital numerals with tabular spacing
Safety-critical defects flagged with warning icon; passenger-count details optional; assists and control messages colour-highlighted; log category icons
Train entry includes a From selector: Working, ASST, ACC or PASS; included in exports
Train activity selector labelled Activity with Working, ASST, ACC, PASS and TAXI choices
Confirmation prompt before deleting an operational log entry
All confirmation prompts use a matching custom CrossCountry modal; train removal, log deletion and clear-all confirmations are consistent with the custom popup design.
Improved readable plain-text shift log and formatted HTML email export
Emoji-led dropdown options for operational log categories and train activity.
Lost Property capture moved into the main Add issue / log entry dropdown with suitcase icon.
Incident Update is a subcategory of incident management; updates append to the original incident entry, selecting an incident only when multiple incidents exist.
Incident capture includes an Incident Number or headcode reference field.
Colour-coded operational categories in PDF and HTML email exports.
PASS and TAXI train activities do not require or display unit numbers; unit number fields are hidden and validation is skipped for these activities.
Each individual operational log entry has a one-tap clipboard copy control (🗒️) and an icon-only delete control (🗑️) with the existing custom confirmation prompt.
PASS and TAXI train records capture mandatory free-text FROM and TO locations; route details appear in the train list, copy log, email and PDF exports.
Compact inline copy and delete controls on each operational log entry
Compact inline copy and delete controls on each operational log entry
Restored PASS/TAXI FROM and TO inputs required by Add Train dialog logic.
PASS/TAXI train reference field label and flexible headcode/reference validation.
Lost Property: optional person details omitted when blank; condition selector; optional compressed item photo included in PDF and HTML email exports.
Operational log entries can optionally be linked to a train from a dropdown; selected train details are included in log text and exports, including incident updates.
Operational log entries now show only a bold bracketed headcode for linked trains.
Train Diversion log entry with selectable diversion routes and custom route additions
Compact PDF layout reduces forced page breaks between Trains and Operational Log
Updated Train Diversion route list with current Newcastle, Yorkshire and Midlands diversionary routes; Other remains available for custom routes.
Primary Shift details, Trains and Operational log sections can be collapsed; train records and operational log entries can be edited in place.
Renamed the Operational log section and export headings to Operational Log / Occurrences.
Lost Property selection opens its dedicated capture form without leaving the general note dialog visible. Train Diversion popup combines diversionary route and optional train selection on one screen.
Full and standing popup with multi-select categories and last/current station
Train Diversion is captured on the single Add log entry screen with mandatory train/headcode selection, route selection and optional custom route saved for future use.
Linked headcodes are consistently displayed in bold red square brackets at the top of every applicable on-screen occurrence and HTML/PDF/email report entry.

Headcode styling hardened: every bracketed four-character headcode in operational entries, including updates, renders bold CrossCountry red using inline and !important styles in on-screen logs and HTML/PDF/email exports.
Operational log entries use a compact three-dot menu for Edit, Copy and Delete actions to save screen space.

Assist entries include multi-select checkboxes for Wheelchair Asst, Ramp Required, Assistance Dog, VIP, Other Mobility, Luggage Assist, General Assist and Other / unknown; selected assistance types are saved in the log and exports.
Assist entries: selecting Wheelchair Asst automatically sets the Seat number field to WC space; unchecking it clears that value if unchanged.
Edited operational log entries show a simple Edited tag without displaying the edit date or time.

Ticket acceptance log entry: operator selector (including custom Other), free-text station fields, railway delay / incident reason selector (including custom Other), optional notes; blank fields are omitted from the saved report text.
Ticket acceptance entries highlighted in pale pink in the on-screen chronological log and exported HTML reports.
Report highlighting: Delay entries exceeding 10 minutes retain a bold red border in HTML and PDF reports; no separate warning label is displayed.
PDF export filename automatically uses DDMMYYYY_TurnNumber, for example 14122026_NES604.
PDF header updated to the newly supplied white-background CrossCountry Voyager banner, displayed 10mm (1cm) high on every printed page; page-number footer retained.
